label: Types and labels
Names and labels
query:
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?s ?name
WHERE {
  ?s ?p ?name .
  FILTER(?p IN (rdfs:label, schema:name))
  FILTER(isLiteral(?name))
}
LIMIT 100

label: Distinct predicates
query:
SELECT DISTINCT ?p
WHERE { ?s ?p ?o }
ORDER BY ?p
LIMIT 200

label: Type counts
query:
SELECT ?type (COUNT(?s) AS ?count)
WHERE { ?s a ?type }
GROUP BY ?type
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
LIMIT 100
